items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: In the meanwhile, Charlie Parker had just hit the scene too.

ctx.x: the top of the head with it. She tried to jump out the window, I wouldn't let her. I say come on back here, (laughter). So I left. Every night, she was across the street, please come back, please come back. No good. No good. I played, I'd done what I could do.

But I think I stranded her, I think I should have stayed with her a little while longer. But having had it and know what it involved and could tell, I just didn't want to be around it. In the meanwhile, Charlie Parker had just hit the scene too. So this was the Vogue, you know, but she had never thought of doing it until this white boy had introduced her to it, you know.
